headline: President Bush created a Homeland Security Advisory Council and senior advisory committees to give the President advice on homeland security.
what_it_does: This executive order set up the President's Homeland Security Advisory Council. It also created senior advisory committees on homeland security. Based on the title, these groups were formed to give advice to the President. No summary was provided, so details about members, duties, and powers are not available here.

who_it_affects.group: Members appointed to the advisory council and committees
who_it_affects.how: They would serve on new advisory bodies that give homeland security advice to the President.

who_it_affects.group: The President and White House homeland security staff
who_it_affects.how: They would receive advice and recommendations from the new council and committees.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 19, 2002; executive orders usually take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
